mark_roles.participant_outline_policy: Opaque borderless filled circles. A 1.6 pt hollow circle with 0.4 pt outline was physically tested first; dense near-ties cannot all fit within the compact facet lanes.
mark_roles.summary_policy: Compact unfilled Q1–Q3 box with a dark median tick; IQR is participant spread, not a confidence interval. Ledger summaries occupy a separate strip below the participant dots in each row.

score_unit: Published deconvolution score; differences are score units, not proportions or percentage points.
summary_interval: Interquartile range of participant differences; not a confidence interval.
